problem_statement: The jcoelho93/personal-website project is a Create React App portfolio (Bulma) for Site Reliability Engineer Jose Coelho, rendered through small component boundaries (Hero/NavBar, About, Skills, Certifications, Experience/Timeline, Articles). The Experience section carries a native 'Filter by career track' control on top of the resume Timeline: chips (All tracks, Reliability, Cloud, DevOps, Support) narrow the timeline to the roles in the chosen discipline and a live readout reports 'Showing N of 9 - <track>'. A shared, read-only 'Career tracks' rail summarising the same vocabulary is meant to appear under the About, Skills and Experience sections so the framing stays consistent wherever roles and skills are discussed. A QA report says the current implementation is broken on three fronts: on a 390px phone the track chip row is a single fixed-width strip that never wraps and forces the whole page to scroll sideways (horizontal overflow); the shared 'Career tracks' rail is missing from the About and Skills sections; and although clicking a track chip re-filters the timeline, the 'Showing N of 9' readout is frozen and keeps reporting 'Showing 9 of 9 - All tracks'. Repair the career-track filter so the chip row wraps responsively with no mobile overflow, the shared rail is present under About, Skills and Experience, the chip row and timeline stay legible (no dark-on-dark collapse or overlapping cards), and the readout updates to the selected track's live count, without changing the resume data, the timeline entries, or any unrelated section.
required_content: Fix the horizontal overflow of the career-track chip row on mobile viewports (390px wide): the track chips must wrap onto multiple rows and the document must not scroll sideways beyond a small tolerance.
Keep the shared read-only 'Career tracks' rail (.track-rail) present under the About, Skills and Experience sections so the track vocabulary is consistent across the page.

Keep the career-track filter chip row and the Experience timeline legible: no dark-on-dark text, no overlapping or shingled timeline cards, no chips clipped off the viewport on the default desktop layout.

Wire the track filter so that clicking a track chip updates the live readout to 'Showing N of 9 - <track>' for the selected discipline (e.g. clicking DevOps shows 'Showing 3 of 9 - DevOps'), matching the timeline entries actually displayed.

Preserve the existing portfolio identity and sections: Jose Coelho, Site Reliability Engineer, About, Skills, Certifications, Experience timeline (PagerDuty, Mindera, feedzai and the other real roles), Articles, and the mobile navigation menu.

Keep the change scoped to the career-track filter component, its stylesheet, the shared rail and its section whitelist: do not add dependencies, routes, generated media, remote API requirements, or a page rewrite.
design_constraints: Treat this as an implementation-continuity repair of the Experience timeline's own career-track filter and its shared summary rail, not a visual redesign or rebrand.
Follow the existing Bulma style vocabulary: light card surfaces, the site's blue accent (#3273dc) for the active chip, and legible dark text on light chrome.
Fix the overflow by making the chip row wrap and flex (flex-wrap + min-width:0), not by clipping the document or hiding content.
Keep the timeline items flowing in a single clean column; do not pull them together with negative margins into an overlapping pile.
Do not change company names, the resume data, the section ids used by the navbar, the certificate images, or the article cards.
The task must be verifiable from the local build with no external network dependency.
state_constraints: Mobile states are captured at 390px wide; the career-track chip row is the region under test for horizontal overflow.
Desktop states are captured at 1440px and tablet states at 834px; the chip row and timeline must stay within the viewport and remain legible at those widths too.
desktop_track_devops clicks the DevOps track chip and asserts the readout changed from the pre-click 'Showing 9 of 9 - All tracks' to 'Showing 3 of 9 - DevOps'.
desktop_skills and desktop_about confirm the shared 'Career tracks' rail is present under those sections.
mobile_menu_open opens the Bulma navbar burger menu to confirm navigation still works on mobile after the repair.

change_completion: The career-track chip row no longer forces horizontal document overflow on a 390px mobile viewport; the chips wrap onto multiple rows.
Clicking a track chip updates the live readout to 'Showing N of 9 - <track>' for the selected discipline, matching the timeline entries shown.
The shared 'Career tracks' rail is present under the About, Skills and Experience sections; the timeline entries and resume data are unchanged.
Every other section (About, Skills, Certifications, Experience, Articles) and the portfolio identity remain intact.
design_consistency: The filter keeps the site's Bulma style vocabulary: light card surfaces, blue active chip, legible dark text; it is not a redesign or rebrand.
The chip row and timeline cards stay legible and evenly spaced; no dark-on-dark text and no overlapping/shingled cards.
The active track chip is visually distinct and the readout is clearly associated with the timeline it controls.
regression: The static build still serves without a custom dev server and with zero console or network errors.
The desktop (1440px) and tablet (834px) layout of the filter and every other section is clean and non-overlapping after the repair.
Navigation (the Bulma navbar and its mobile burger menu) still works after the fix.
responsive: 390px mobile initial and mobile Experience have no horizontal overflow beyond the 24px tolerance.
The track chips reflow cleanly onto multiple rows on mobile without clipping content or hiding the document scrollbar to mask the overflow.
Desktop and tablet widths continue to show the chip row and timeline without overflow or collapse.

author_notes: Retrofitted to product-grade L4 on the jcoelho93 personal-website portfolio. The lever is the Experience timeline's own career-track filter (TrackFilter.js) plus a shared read-only Career-tracks rail (TrackRail.js) whitelisted per section via trackSurfaces.js. Four orthogonal gates: no_horizontal_overflow (mobile chip-row wrap, tolerance 24), visual_regression on the desktop and mobile Experience lever crops (pixelmatch + ssim + block_fidelity over the .track-filter component image), dom_assertions on the cross-section rail presence (About/Skills/Experience), and interaction_assertions on the live 'Showing N of 9' readout after a DevOps chip click. INFRA identical across all three legs (not part of the repair): the TrackFilter/TrackRail/trackData components, the Experience/About/Skills mounts, and the removal of the remote fontawesome/analytics/credly scripts from index.html. Reference wraps and stays legible; baseline is the original responsive defect (fixed-width non-wrapping chip row, rail only under Experience) that still filters correctly; the bad solution collapses the chip row and timeline into an illegible dark-on-dark overlapping pile, drops the Skills rail, and freezes the readout while the click still registers. The reference build renders offline with zero console or network errors, 5+ local images including public/images/jcoelho.webp, and the Bulma svg/webp certificate badges.
